title: kbgit.py splits along its change boundaries behind the unchanged CLI
goal: kbgit.py holds the command line, the usage text and the dispatch, and its sync, trailer, hook and lane code lives in kg_lane.py, kg_sync.py, kg_trailers.py and kg_hooks.py beside kg_base.py and kg_merge.py; every command, its output, its exit codes and every test name are as before, and backlog.py land names the code/<id> branch through one helper that takes the root and no longer swaps a module global.
notes: kbgit.py's hotspots are sync, lane_plan, push_branch and check-lanes; land calls into it. The branch-name helper takes a root so backlog.py land no longer swaps kbgit.KB (KG1 first). test_layout bans a kg_ module reaching kbgit at any depth. Tests keep their names and patch targets move with the code. ST-csdjyfat edits kbgit.py: the split lands first or it rebases onto the new modules. The split lands as one atomic commit per file, announced first, with held showing no claimed touches on kbgit.py.
